scripts.generate: pnpm --filter @qelvora/api generate && node scripts/generate-shared.mjs && node scripts/generate-native-api.mjs
scripts.generate:check: pnpm --filter @qelvora/api generate --check && node scripts/generate-shared.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-native-api.mjs --check
scripts.lint: eslint apps/backend packages apps/web scripts tests playwright.config.ts --ignore-pattern '**/generated/**'
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages config scripts tests '*.json' '*.yaml' '.github/**/*.yml'
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages config scripts tests '*.json' '*.yaml' '.github/**/*.yml'
scripts.check: pnpm generate:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test && pnpm build
